summary: Backend: 25/25 pytest pass (students CRUD, bono 5/10 validation, renew, attendance Tue/Thu + range validation, 409 duplicate, 400 at 0 classes, undo restore, delete cascades attendance, monthly summary 4€=2+2, class-days). Concurrency spot-check: no duplicate/negative balances observed. Frontend (375x667): default day = Jue 5 nov (correct for Mon 9 Nov), day chips switch, add student (bono 5) -> 5 clases/10€, register -> 4 clases/8€ + 'Asistió' disabled, per-day state correct, renew +5, Historial grouped by date with Deshacer restoring balance, Resumen month chips & totals (4.00€ / 2+2) and per-student items, delete with confirm modal. All flows working. Main real bug: attendance time shown in Historial will be wrong for users outside UTC (naive datetime from Mongo).

minor.issue: created_at returned without timezone (e.g. '2026-11-09T19:02:44.596000', no Z/+00:00) because Motor returns naive datetimes. Frontend formatTime() parses it as LOCAL time -> in Spain (UTC+1/+2) Historial shows the time 1-2h early. Fix: AsyncIOMotorClient(mongo_url, tz_aware=True) or serialize with explicit UTC offset.

Default limit=500 and frontend calls it without params; with ~20 students x 78 class days (~1500 records) older 'Asistió' states and Historial entries will silently disappear. Consider filtering by class_date or paginating.

Duplicate check + decrement are non-atomic and there is no unique index on (student_id, class_date); a race could double-register/go negative. Not reproduced with 10 concurrent requests, but add unique compound index and conditional update (classes_remaining > 0).
When class_date omitted it uses server date.today() (UTC) instead of the client's day.

ui_bugs.issue: Time displayed via new Date(naive ISO) -> wrong hour for non-UTC devices (see backend minor issue).

issues: Deshacer fires immediately with no confirmation and no onError handler/toast; accidental taps remove attendance silently, failures are silent.
Bottom tab labels appear slightly clipped at bottom in 375x667 web preview.
Bottom sheet does not add insets.bottom padding; action buttons sit close to the home indicator on iPhone.

action_items: Make datetimes timezone-aware (AsyncIOMotorClient(..., tz_aware=True)) so created_at serializes with +00:00 and Historial shows correct local time
Add confirmation (or undo toast) + onError handling for Deshacer in historial.tsx
Add unique index on attendance (student_id, class_date) and atomic conditional decrement
Avoid 500-record limit for attendance list used by Alumnos 'Asistió' state (query by class_date)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: renew overwrites bono_type with the latest renewal type (fine, but bono_type then no longer reflects initial bono)
index.tsx is 645 lines; consider splitting modals (AddStudentModal, RenewBonoModal) into components
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found; safe-area handled via useSafeAreaInsets
seed_data_creation: None. TEST_ students created and deleted by id; seed María García (10/20€) and Juan Pérez (5/10€) verified unchanged, attendance collection empty after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server date 2026-11-09 (Mon). Run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_asistencia_api.py. Modals slide in - wait ~1.5s after opening before clicking. Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: Wrong Historial time: Motor default tz_aware=False returns naive UTC datetimes; Pydantic serializes them without offset; JS Date treats offset-less ISO datetime as local time.
